phase: HF4-C1 matched positive-gap contact paths; not HF5 admission

material.regularization_scope: A0 zero; Aalpha all solid; TMC all elements without gamma scaling

profile: q=-x-1 on [-2,0]; q=1-2*abs(x-1) on [0,2]; q=x-3 on [2,4]; continuous PWL, both body and whole bottom mean zero
boundary: bottom uy prescribed; bottom x=1 ux=0 only; other ux free; reference top free before closure then uy=gap; TMC top uy=0; sides natural
admission: All four uniform paths must pass numerical, provenance and geometry gates before six perturbation paths. Every perturbation stage independently checks its inherited zero-amplitude state. Failed or tensile reference branches stop dependent comparisons; retain accepted prefix and failure. Never relax gates after observation.
comparison: Model differences are measured outcomes, not implementation tolerances: no prospective agreement percentage is assumed. Report absolute precontact force, total top normal reaction, body displacement/gap and two-level sensitivity. TMC minus Aalpha includes background medium, boundaries and nonlinear coupling; not pure contact error. Aalpha is diagnostic, not physical truth.
